best_lineage.idea: Replace the slow recursive merge sort with a hybrid LSD Radix Sort that uses insertion sort for small arrays (<=32 elements), processes data in 4 passes of 8-bit buckets using a static scratch buffer to avoid heap overhead, and includes an optimization to skip a pass if all keys share the same digit for that bit range.
